description: This file defines the TagRepository class, which manages Tag entities and their associations with notes. It provides methods for retrieving, inserting, updating, deleting, and copying tags, as well as managing tag-note relationships and synchronizing changes.

classes.name: TagRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing Tag entities and their associations with notes, providing CRUD operations and sync functionalities.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a Flow stream of all tags.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Flow stream of a Tag by its ID.

methods.name: getByNoteId
methods.description: Retrieves a Flow stream of tags associated with a specific note ID.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Flow stream of a Tag by its name.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new Tag and returns its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes tags and optionally triggers a sync to update related notes.

methods.name: addTagToNote
methods.description: Associates a tag with a note and optionally syncs the change.

methods.name: deleteTagFromNote
methods.description: Removes a tag from a note and optionally syncs the change.

methods.name: copyTags
methods.description: Copies tags from one note to another.
